# ADR-3220: AWS network: NACL allow-all ephemeral rule for VPC 4

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Over-broad NACLs weaken defense in depth.

## Decision

Teams MUST NOT rely on a NACL allow-all ephemeral rule for VPC 4 (AWS-network-4) unless an exception is explicitly documented.

## Consequences

NACLs complement security groups deliberately.
